segments.he: ספרו לפני מהרנ"ת ז"ל שהצדיק ר' מאיר מפרימשלאן אומר הללוהו "בתוף ומחול" היינו הללו את ה' שהסוף יהי' שימחלו" "לובט השם יתברך ווארין דער סוף וועט זיין מען מעט מוחל זייל". השיב מהרנ"ת שכן הוא שימחלו האדער פין שמיץ וועט מען זיך מט אוס דראייאין".
segments.en: Our fellowship, when they heard this, their hearts melted within them and they did not know what counsel to take — whether to tell Moharan'as or not. No one wanted to bring such news to Moharan'as. Only the righteous Idel daughter of Rabbainu — when she heard this — could not contain herself and ran immediately to Moharan'as's house. He was always in his upper room, closed and sealed there in the service of G-d — and she went up immediately. When Moharan'as saw her, he was greatly astonished that she came so early in the morning — for he also saw wondrous allusions in this, always looking at the allusions of each day. And now, first thing in the morning, his first sight was the seed of Rabbainu standing before him. He asked her what she wanted, and she told him in fear and trembling: "Do you not know that they have sent for Pinchasil?" He stood a moment as if stunned — and replied: "He will most likely not come." "Mestome vet er nit kumen." She said again: "But they have already sent a special wagon for him!" He replied again: "He will most likely not come." When she heard him say this several times, she was reassured and returned home.
